scope: offline testnet Vault candidate and local RPC fixtures
verifiedBehaviors: Deployment begins inactive and activation pins the reciprocal asset and registry configuration
Each paused chain blocks local bridge ingress and claims while ordinary wWL transfers continue
An unused registered root can be corrected while paused and a consumed root cannot be changed
A failed WL payout preserves the claim and collateral for an alternate payout authorized by the original recipient
One WL serializes as a canonical JSON-RPC quantity in the browser wallet client
Provider log limits are handled by bounded splitting and receipt lookup can fall back to per-transaction RPC
Completed proof jobs do not count against active capacity
Testnet RPC transport rejects broadcast methods

remaining.usedRootIncidentRecovery: Requires reconciliation across both chains before resuming
remaining.recipientRecovery: Requires a call from the recipient committed in the source burn
